description: This header file declares functions related to the Message Bus interface for the SSP component, including initialization, finalization, and resource management.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specific component ID, configuration file, and registration path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus module with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus status.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources with given priority and user data.
